startFresh.title: Start fresh
startFresh.sub: One time only, on go-live day: clear the test and sample business data so the live shop starts from zero.

card.title: Start fresh (one time only)
card.lead: Clears all test and sample business data so the live shop starts from zero. Use it once, on go-live day.
card.guard: Owner only · full backup first · type START FRESH + PIN

how.HANDED_OFF: cleared by the server's own clean-up

switch.off: Start fresh is switched off. Switch it on only on go-live day.

startFresh.backupOk: A fresh backup is safe in Drive ({when}).
startFresh.backupOld: The newest backup is too old. Back up again.
startFresh.backupOpen: A backup is running. Wait for it, then reload.
startFresh.removeProducts: Also remove the demo products (archived, can be brought back). Products you uploaded always stay
startFresh.warn: This runs once. After it, the button is gone for ever.
startFresh.done: Started fresh on {when}. This can only be done once.
startFresh.doneNote: Some records are cleared by the server's own clean-up: the ERP and the server finish them. The ERP's test entries are not sent yet.
startFresh.ownerOnly: Only the owner can use this page.

errors.OWNER_ONLY: Only the owner can do this.
errors.BACKUP_FIRST: Make a full backup first. It must be recent.
errors.ALREADY_DONE: Start fresh has already been done. It runs only once.
errors.RUN_FAILED: It could not finish, so nothing was cleared. Try again or ask for help.
errors.BUSY: A backup is waiting or running already.
errors.PIN_NOT_SET: The owner has not set a PIN yet.
errors.PIN_LOCKED: Too many wrong tries. Wait a while.
